notes.title: #StayAtHomeSales
notes.content:
Hello Folks! 
We know that all around the world the situation is really tricky due to COVID-19!
We all must avoid to go out, and we must #StayAtHome.

To try to make your quarantine better, we decided, for the first time ever, to make a 90% discount on our game! If you liked the Free Edition, you will not find a better occasion to play the full experience in the Definitive Edition.

We hope you'll enjoy your quarantine playing TWL!

Regards,
CyberCoconut Team!

notes.title: The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION - The UpdaTUX
TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #10 - Release!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/03fd4a6307811f722a50fc645724cbc2ad71d5f8.png[/img]


Hey guys! The day has come!

The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION is now officially out all over the world for Windows! We are starting on Steam, but we are planning on releasing the game on other platforms as well. If you are new here, welcome!  If you are a fan of the game, thank you! Your support meant the world to us, thanks to your enthusiasm and feedback we managed to complete the game.

Have fun!

CyberCoconut team

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/c541b7d1b734872724b2074b9f2473447ef54773.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 9! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
There are 90 artworks in the game, 3 for each level. These include concept arts, mood paintings and character designs. You unlock them by completing a level in all of its choices.

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
There is one ending we ended up cutting from the final release. It felt like a great and funny idea at the time, but after some time we realized it was more like a huge joke than anything else, so we decided to take it out.

[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
He looks grumpy all the time, but underneath it all he’s a softy.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/a55fcba4a95a858c93e0c2860ca1a957a5a6a8d5.png[/img]

[h1]QUOTE OF THE DAY[/h1]

"Know how to listen and you will profit even from those who talk badly."  -  [i]Plutarch[/i]

[h1]SCREENSHOT[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/56124e28709986949a8967638e78f67a11fe23f8.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 8! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
We have a whole room dedicated to the credits, where each developer has his or her own personal statue. A good way to thank all the amazing people who worked really hard to develop the game!

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
Between the first prototype and the launch edition we went through 10 main versions of Unity during Development, from 4.6 to 2017.2. Sometimes the changes were so drastic we had to take a few weeks to make sure everything was updated correctly to the new version. 

[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
Cyberbanana’s CEO: a man of heavy influence in the tech industry. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/eb991c6d23c1258cc67a1e60e7a9ff6de5011397.png[/img]

[h1]QUOTE OF THE DAY[/h1]

"You can never know everything, and part of what you know is always wrong. A portion of wisdom lies in knowing that. A portion of courage lies in going on anyway."  -  [i]Robert Jordan[/i]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/bc681b1a751974e45e404ca227fddb6676967307.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 6! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
To complete the whole game, unlocking every trophy and every achievement, the average player will need approximately 10 hours. If you want, you can get through the game in about 4 hours, playing each level only once.

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
The most difficult level to create for us, from a design point, was the tutorial. Overall we tried 5 completely different iterations before setting on the one you’ll find in the DEFINITIVE EDITION. 

[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
One of the best teacher around. Be careful not to upset her, or you’ll be in trouble!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/5e74c7c489b3b4c112cc055082a5a50894c5a287.png[/img]

[h1]QUOTE OF THE DAY[/h1]

"Nothing in life is to be feared; it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more so that we may fear less.."  -  [i]Marie Curie[/i]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 5! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
Today we are going to talk about the music in the game. The soundtrack composed by Luigi Di Guida is made of 15 tracks for a total of half an hour of music! Every experience has a unique background music, with different variations. 

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
In a team so small, everyone has to cover more than one role. Our game director Davide tested the game a lot: he has 200 hours of playtime on steam and the game isn’t out yet!

She’s the new kid in town. She’s friendly and ready to start new adventures!

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/db79ed4195a7b8ec513b59cae9e27ea034e6ee37.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 4! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
We’ve already talked about choices in Road to Release #1. We want to expand a little bit by talking about how choices impact the game ending. Every level is open from the beginning and replayable, but only the first choice the player take in a level will be recorded for the ending. So if you play through one level for the first time and you are dissatisfied with your choice, you can replay it any time you want, but the first choice you took is the one that’s going to influence the final ending. 

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
Back in February 2017 The Way of Life Game Director Davide was invited by Microsoft to showcase the game at their GDC event in San Francisco. It was his first time flying. After a 16 hours flight, he swore never to set foot on a plane again.

[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
Music is her passion. She expresses angst through her guitar. Member of the Howling Dungeon heavy metal band.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/0d7107a4e770b9a86b00b7764b879a7b0b83b904.png[/img]

[h1]QUOTE OF THE DAY[/h1]

"If people sat outside and looked at the stars each night, I'll bet they'd live a lot differently."  -  [i]Bill Watterson[/i]

TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #3

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/434b19b600d6b4454ea11caf551be76da3f70b92.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 3! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
Did you know that the three characters are related to each other? The Kid is the Adult’s son and the Oldman’s nephew. Even if all the experiences are open and accessible from the very beginning, all stories are in some way linked, and it is possible to trace a timeline if you play all the experiences! 

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
During production we assigned a code name to each character, main or secondary, based on their predominant color. For example, we called the Kid “Red”, the Adult “Blue” and the Oldman is “Brown”. We did this to better organize the project and to improve visual identification of each character, so that every character would be instantly recognized based on their color.

[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
You probably shouldn’t trust this guy, even if he could help you.

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release, stage 2! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
After watching the trailer, someone commented on the presence of guns in the game. Today in this feature spotlight we want to touch on that a bit. Even if the game features guns in a couple of experiences, those are just a small fraction of the whole game, and both times it is well contextualized. They are not there for the sake of it! If, after watching the trailer, you are scared of finding another game with guns… rest assured! That’s not what The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION is about!

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
The first prototype of The Way of Life was created over the weekend of January 26th 2014 during Global Game Jam 2014. That means The Way of Life has been around for a little more than 4 years! 
 
[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
This character is an artist and a rebel inside. He believes he can change the world with his art.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123966/b3139a9685a6cef56497663f3f84aea9f08959d0.png[/img]

Hello! Welcome to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url] road to release! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

[h1]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT[/h1] 
In the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]DEFINITIVE EDITION [/url]of the game, there are more than 75 choices to make! What does that mean exactly? Each level has 2 or more choices (some more obvious than others) that the player will need to face. Every choice will lead to a different ending of the level, and If you can find them all, you’ll get a nice surprise!

[h1]FUN FACT[/h1]
Over the course of the development (from the very beginning of the first prototype) we made exactly 1500 commit on github. That means we “updated” the game 1500 times! 
 
[h1]CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
This character is an adventurous kid! He’s always curious about everything, which makes him quite the troublemaker! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123966/3e143e04e6d848fab7e6f583e54e35872676fe03.png[/img]

[h1]QUOTE OF THE DAY[/h1]

notes.title: Welcome to The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION steam page
notes.content:
Hello, we are finally ready to release the game on March 15th, 2018! Save the date!
Looking back, 4 years ago, we couldn’t have predicted that what started as a small prototype made in 48h during Global Game Jam would take us on this long, hard but exciting journey. We are very proud of what we achieved during these years. We are now ready to share the product of our work with all of you hoping that you will enjoy the game as much as we did while developing it!
If you are interested in the game, remember to put it in your wishlist to always be up to date.

Stay tuned!

CyberCoconut Team.
